title: Human approval with structured form — access request
description: An automated agent checks access policy and data sensitivity. The workflow then pauses for a Security Officer to fill in a structured approval form: grant duration, access scope confirmation, and audit notes. The form schema enforces required fields and types.

human_task.title: Access grant approval — READ on prod-analytics-db
human_task.description: Grant or deny READ access for svc:reporting-service to prod-analytics-db. Complete all required form fields.

approved.description: Approve or reject the access request

grant_duration_days.description: Number of days to grant access (1–90)

scope_confirmed.description: Confirm that READ-only scope is appropriate for this service

payload.justification: New reporting pipeline requires read access to analytics tables for daily aggregation job
